activity.notes: Naemul Maripgan was Silla's 17th ruler and is conventionally assigned a reign of 356–402. ATLAS uses the historically specific Maripgan title rather than retrojecting a later royal title.

sources.title: 내물마립간
sources.citation_text: The Encyclopedia of Korean Culture identifies Naemul Maripgan as Silla's 17th ruler and gives his reign as 356–402.
